subject: PO format, invoice cadence and discount eligibility — Medicore
messages:
From: Marta López <marta.lopez@medicore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@medicore.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO format & invoice cadence constraints — Medicore

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement had a quick review and we need to confirm a few constraints before we can move to a PO:

- Our AP system requires a PO that contains the following fields exactly: BillingEntityID, ERPProjectCode, and ClientContactRef (they must be top-level fields in the PO file).
- Net terms are standard Net60 for all new vendors in our health group; we cannot commit to Net30 without an exception.
- Invoice cadence: preferred consolidated monthly statement (one PDF per calendar month). We can accept weekly invoices only if the invoice filename follows this pattern: Medicore_INV_<YYYYMMDD>_<PO#.pdf.
- For discount qualification: we can apply standard volume discounts if you provide an SKU mapping and indicate if pricing is "prepay/commitment" or "usage".
- As part of our audit controls we need a one-page attestation confirming the legal entity we will bill and the BU code that should appear on invoices.

I've attached our PO template (PO_template_Medicore.xlsx) and an example PO export (PO_example.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can produce invoices with the required fields and the consolidated monthly statement? Also let us know if any discount tiers are available under Net60.

Best,
Marta López
Senior Sourcing Manager — Medicore Health
attachments: PO_template_Medicore.xlsx, PO_example.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta López <marta.lopez@medicore.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format & invoice cadence constraints — Medicore

Hi Marta — really appreciate the detail, that helps. Quick answers and a proposed compromise below.

1) PO fields: yes — we can populate BillingEntityID, ERPProjectCode, and ClientContactRef on our invoice PDFs and CSV metadata exports. I attached a CSV mapping (redwood-po-field-mapping.csv) showing how Redwood fields map to your template. If you need a different header name, tell us the exact string and we’ll mirror it.

2) Invoice cadence / filenames: we can produce consolidated monthly statements as a single PDF. We can also generate weekly invoice PDFs that follow your filename pattern. We’ll need the PO number format (length and prefix) so our generator produces the exact filename.

3) Net terms & discounts: our standard commercial offer provides a 2.0% early-pay discount for invoices paid within 15 days, and a separate volume discount tier for annual precommitments. We understand Medicore’s Net60 policy — our proposed options are:
   - Accept Net60 and offer a 0.75% volume discount for the first 12 months (applies to committed spend tiers); or
   - If Medicore can agree to Net45, we can extend a 1.5% early-pay equivalent (applies automatically when payments clear within 45 days).

4) Attestation: we can supply a one-page billing attestation that lists the Redwood legal entity and BU tags.

Next steps: if the Net60 + 0.75% sounds workable, we’ll update the HubSpot quote and send a short amendment for signatures. Otherwise, if you can escalate for Net45 we can push the 1.5% option.

Link to proposed quote: https://app.docusign.com/quotes/REW-QUOTE-8742

I’ve cc’d Priyom for finance/ops validation on filename generation and PO mapping.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-po-field-mapping.csv
From: Procurement Ops <procurement@medicore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta López <marta.lopez@medicore.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format & invoice cadence constraints — Medicore

Karthik — thanks for the fast follow-up and the mapping file. A few clarifications from AP after reviewing your proposal: 

- The PO number format we use is alphanumeric, always 12 characters (e.g., MDCR-00012345). Please ensure your filename generator supports the hyphen.
- Consolidated monthly statement is preferred (one PDF). Weekly invoices will be a fallback during an onboarding ramp only.
- Discount note: our procurement policy does not apply volume discounts for first-year onboarding unless the vendor accepts prepayment or a blanket commitment. We can make an exception only for strategic partners with an approved procurement waiver.
- The attestation is required and must be on letterhead.

We can discuss escalation for Net45 with Treasury, but it is not likely without exec approval. If you can provide a short waiver request template we’ll route it internally.

We attached the example PO export again (PO_example.pdf) and added comments in red. If you can confirm filename generation and the ability to render BillingEntityID as a visible field in the PDF (not just embedded metadata), we can move to the PO issuance stage.

Regards,
Procurement Ops — Medicore
attachments: PO_example.pdf (with comments)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta López <marta.lopez@medicore.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@medicore.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format & invoice cadence constraints — Medicore

Marta / Procurement team — thank you. Internal readout and clear next steps below.

Summary of constraints from Medicore: PO must include BillingEntityID / ERPProjectCode / ClientContactRef, invoice filenames must match the hyphenated 12-char PO format, and Net60 is the default. Medicore prefers consolidated monthly statements and requires an attestation on letterhead.

Our proposal (final):
- Redwood will accept Net60 for onboarding. In exchange we offer a baseline volume discount of 0.5% for the first 12 months (applies to committed tiers).
- If Medicore is able to sign a 12-month commitment with a quarterly prepay schedule, we will increase the discount to 1.25%.
- We will produce consolidated monthly statement PDFs by default. During the first 30 days of onboarding we can emit weekly invoices (properly named) to facilitate reconciliation.
- We will provide a one-page attestation on Redwood letterhead and an updated PO field mapping document.

Action items:
1) (Marta) confirm whether the 0.5% baseline discount is acceptable under Net60 so we can update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-3091).
2) (Priyom) finalize the filename generator and send a test set (sample PDFs + filenames) to procurement this week.
3) (Vanessa) estimate any revenue/contracting implications of the 0.5% baseline and sign-off on the amendment language.

If you confirm acceptance, we’ll push the amendment to DocuSign and prep the PO fields mapping for AP.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-po-field-mapping.csv
